note: Haulers. baseSpeed is tiles per second on open flat ground. A road tile multiplies it by the road's speedMult; rough terrain divides it by the tile's move cost raised to offroad. carries says which resource phases can ride. Air vehicles ignore terrain, water and roads entirely. tiers are the upgrade steps bought at a garage.

vehicles.name: Scout Rover

cryonite.name: Rime Rover
cryonite.desc: Studded tracks. Ice stops being slow ground and starts being a road.

voltaic_ore.name: Arc Rover
voltaic_ore.desc: Runs on a voltaic cell and never visits a fuel tank.

vehicles.desc: The first truck out of the pod. Small load, quick, and it can go anywhere a person can.

vehicles.name: Hauler

ferrovine.name: Vine-Framed Hauler
ferrovine.desc: A ferrovine chassis weighs nothing and carries a quarter more.

vehicles.desc: The standard crate truck. Slow off-road, fine on gravel, excellent on pavement.

vehicles.name: Heavy Hauler

pyrocrystal.name: Ash-Runner
pyrocrystal.desc: Shielded underbody. Crosses ash flats that would cook a normal truck.

vehicles.desc: Three times the load of a hauler and it really wants a paved road. On raw terrain it crawls.

vehicles.name: Tanker

cryonite.name: Cryo Tanker
cryonite.desc: Lined with cryonite, so liquids arrive at the temperature they left at.

vehicles.desc: The only way to move liquids overland. Punctures badly if raiders catch it.

vehicles.name: Gas Hauler

umbral_shale.name: Void-Lined Hauler
umbral_shale.desc: Shale lining holds a third more pressure without leaking.

vehicles.desc: Pressure bottles on wheels. Slow, and you do not want it parked near a flame turret.

vehicles.name: Hover Truck

aetherite.name: Aether Skiff
aetherite.desc: An aetherite lift ring. Barely touches the ground at all.

vehicles.desc: Barely notices terrain and flies on a hover lane. Draws grid power the whole time it runs.

vehicles.name: Cargo Drone

glimmer_salt.name: Glimmer Drone
glimmer_salt.desc: A glimmer lens under the hull doubles as a flying scanner.

vehicles.desc: Tiny load, straight line, ignores water, cliffs and roadblocks. Flying turrets eat them.

vehicles.name: Skimmer

voltaic_ore.name: Storm Skimmer
voltaic_ore.desc: Grounded hull. The only flyer that stays up in a storm.

vehicles.desc: Barely carries anything - it is an exploration vehicle. Fastest thing you own and it sees fourteen tiles.

vehicles.name: Airship

helium3.name: Helium Lifter
helium3.desc: Helium-3 in the envelope lifts forty per cent more.

vehicles.desc: Enormous load, crawling speed, carries anything and goes over everything. Storms are a real problem.

vehicles.name: Builder Buggy

xenoplasm.name: Vat Buggy
xenoplasm.desc: A xenoplasm skin that closes its own holes between jobs.

vehicles.desc: Carries its own materials to an outline and works on it. Two and a half times a walking builder.
